items.title: Kaziranga Heritage opens with 28 keys in Assam
items.snippet: Kaziranga Heritage, a 28-key retreat in Assam, has opened with a focus on heritage, wilderness and destination-led hospitality. Launched in March 2026, the property brings together the historic Bonani bungalow, Assamese architecture and cuisine, local craftsmanship and curated experiences around Kaziranga. The property has been developed around the Bonani bungalow, which has guest records dating back to 1938.

items.title: R2 expands Mallorca portfolio
items.snippet: DUISBURG – R2 , the hotel brand of Schauinsland-Reisen , will manage and operate two additional properties in Mallorca . The new portfolio additions are the R2 Paguera Park and the R2 Ponent in the resort of Paguera. The expansion adds a family-oriented resort and a seafront apartment property to the group’s Mallorca portfolio.

items.title: PolyU scholar Prof. Kaye Chon conferred honorary doctorate
items.snippet: PolyU's SHTM Dean Prof. Kaye Chon received an honorary doctorate from Prince of Songkla University, Thailand, honoring his lifelong contributions to hospitality and tourism education.

items.title: Soul Community Planet, Inc. Launches Public Investment Campaign to Expand Its Holistic Hospitality® Reach
items.snippet: SCP, a 10-property wellness-focused boutique hotel brand, has launched a Regulation CF public investment campaign targeting $300M in equity to grow beyond 2,000 rooms.

items.title: Landing at Western Sydney Airport? Where to Stay and Go Next
items.snippet: The opening of Western Sydney International Airport is reshaping how travellers experience Australia’s financial capital – starting in the city’s west.

items.title: Geneva Tourism targets Indian leisure travellers
items.snippet: Geneva Tourism, along with Manotel Hotel Group Geneva and Initium, is stepping up efforts to attract Indian leisure travellers and position Geneva as a holiday destination in the Indian market. The partners recently hosted a select group of media representatives at a luncheon at Kathiwada House in Worli, Mumbai.

items.title: How This Airline Is Growing Its Network Without Adding a Single Plane
items.snippet: Skift Take: Who said airlines have to fly every route they sell? Low-cost-carrier Tigerair Taiwan is testing a way to tap another carrier’s network, sell the journey itself, and skip the traditional interline setup. Airlines have traditionally grown their networks by adding flights or partnering with other carriers through interline and codeshare agreements.

items.title: 300+ objections filed against Maidstone hotel conversion plan
items.snippet: More than 300 objections have been filed against plans to convert the former Grange Moor Hotel and wedding venue in Maidstone, Kent, into a 42-unit co-living development that could accommodate around 65 people. Residents have raised concerns over parking, pressure on local infrastructure, the scale of the proposed development and its potential impact on the character of the neighbourhood.

items.title: Royal Caribbean expands Alaska Cruises with new experiences
items.snippet: Royal Caribbean is offering a range of Alaska cruise experiences for the upcoming season, combining scenic coastal voyages with inland adventures and immersive destination experiences. Operating between April and September, the itineraries feature seven-night cruises and extended Cruisetours ranging from two to six nights, including opportunities to explore Denali National Park and other iconic Alaskan destinations.

items.title: Malaysia Aviation Group signs deal to acquire Airbus SAE
items.snippet: Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) has signed a Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA) with Airbus to acquire Sepang Aircraft Engineering (SAE), a wholly owned subsidiary of Airbus Group.
